Traffic Advisory – Isleville Street – Manhole Replacement

From 8:00 AM to approximately 6:00 PM on Monday, November 3rd, Halifax Water crews will be on-site performing a manhole replacement at the intersection of Isleville Street and Bilby Street, Halifax.

The intersection will be closed. Traffic will be detoured.

This work will not impact Halifax Water services in the area.

https://t.co/82y9XwFSvJ
